description: ClawOS cgroup v2 resource quota standard values. These are calibration baselines — P4 will fine-tune based on benchmarks, but architecture must be designed to these limits.

memory.note: 512MB hard max, 400MB soft high, 64MB guaranteed min. No swap ever.

cpu.note: 50% of one core max. Weight 512 = half of default 1024.

pids.note: 128 PIDs covers tokio threads + WASM workers + 2x safety buffer. BLOCKER: verify with C-02 strace.

io.note: 50MB/s read/write. Replace 8:0 with actual disk major:minor at runtime.

wasm_worker.description: Each isolated WASM tool execution worker

memory.note: 128MB per WASM worker. Tools should be lightweight.

cpu.note: 25% of one core per tool worker.

pids.note: WASM workers should be single-threaded + minimal helper threads.

memory.note: 64MB — eBPF maps live in kernel, userspace just reads ring buffer.

cpu.note: 10% max — monitoring should be nearly invisible.

memory.note: 256MB — HNSW index can be large depending on vector count.

global_constraints.note: No swap anywhere in ClawOS. OOM kills the offending process, not the system.
